infobox.usage: Unlocks the manager's office on the second floor of the "Sparja" store on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Store manager's key (Store) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to manager's office room inside one of the city stores.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Office on the second floor of the "Sparja" store at Streets of Tarkov. It can be accessed via the staircase in the eastern personnel tract.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Drawer
- 1x PC block
- 1x Safe
- 1x Sport bag
- Loose loot (Flammable materials, Household materials)
